title: Pennsylvania county sold home for $109,000 after notices went to dead owner; court sets sale aside
summary_full: A Pennsylvania appeals court recently ruled to cancel a tax sale of a home in Garnet Valley. The tax sale occurred due to the county's failure to notify the correct property owner about unpaid taxes. Bonnie Wilson's home was sold despite her and her son Kevin both being deceased. The appeals court emphasized the need for tax bureaus to investigate further when notices are returned.
